name: City-on-Web Baking
definition: A block-based neural rendering representation that bakes high-resolution 2D planes and a low-resolution 3D voxel grid per block to compute the attribute function f_k,l for rendering, storing only non-empty voxels in a block-sparse format.
summary: City-on-Web Baking converts neural fields into block-sparse textures for real-time web rendering, distinguishing itself by optimizing storage and transmission for web delivery.
